verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a SaaS project-management service, so choosing a data region or residency is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions region selection or data residency, so the verdict is none. Additional workspaces for sandboxing or sensitive information (shortcut-docs-15) are an adjacent feature about separating work, not about where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
